company.name: Monaqasat
company.shortDescription: Monaqasat is an e-tendering service company that provides contracting to medium and small businesses.
company.description: Monaqasat is a construction management company. They are e-tendering management services and developing an excellent reputation for delivering success. They serve as a source for project leads in industrial, residential, commercial, and public projects. Their projects come from outside the construction sector, such as contracts for ICT supplies, office furnishing, and the supply of machinery.
